title: Mere Baba
body:
Zindane sham se ye ik bachi ki sada h,
Mere pedar tumhara mera gham ek sa hai,
Mere baba jo tum be kafan ho, teri beti bhi to be kafan h,
Tum jo tashna dahen ho aye baba ye sakina bhi tashnadahen h,
Tumne dekha na phirse madina or mujhe bhi mili na rehayi,
Tum bhi baba mere bewatan ho or beti bhi ye be watan h,
Chhin gaya hai lebas apka bhi or kurta mera bhi jala h,
Khaak hi pairahan h tumhara khaak hi ab mera pairahan h,
Hogyi door sari hi khushiya Gulshane fatima se aye baba,
Humse ruthi hain sari bahare Ab khezao ki zad pe chaman h,
Chhan dala h teere sitam ne apke jisme Athar ko baba,
Or durro se ahle sitam k Zakhmi mera bhi sara badan h,
Haye bhayya k sine me barchi dil abhi tak ye bhula nii hai,
Yaad aata hai Zakhmi wo sina ab bhi sine me mere chubhan hai,
Mere asghar se kahna aye baba maaf krde wo apni bahen ko,
Na pila payi tumko mai pani kitni Lachar teri bahen hai,
Is bayaban' ne ik dopaher me humko kitne janaze dikhaye,
Kis qadar berahem or sitam Gar Haye karbobala ka ye bun h,
Kaise is qaid me ho guzara chhar soo hai bala ka andhera,
Chaand ki bhi na ya'n koi zaw h na hi sooraj ki kiran h,
Aisi koi musibat nii h jo sakina k upar na guzri,
Dekho gardan pe meri aye baba ab bhi baaqi nishaane Rasan hai,
Ab bhi roti hai suhail bachi Baap ko apne qaide sitam me,
14 sadiyo se bachi k lab per Haye parvez bus ik Sukhan hai,
